# NBT Vasudha Summit 2027 & Sustainability Awards 2026

> India's bilingual (Hindi–English) sustainability summit and awards, presented by Navbharat Times (NBT) and Times Internet Languages Live. Both events take place on 13 February 2027 at Bharat Mandapam, Pragati Maidan, New Delhi: the summit by day (from 9:30 AM) and the awards night in the evening (from 6:30 PM). Tagline: संकल्प से प्रभाव तक ("from resolve to impact").

Dates, venue, categories and fees are indicative and subject to final confirmation by the organisers.

## Pages

- [NBT Vasudha Summit 2027 (English)](https://timeslanguages.in/nbtvasudha/): programme, schedule, delegate passes, partnerships, contacts, FAQ
- [NBT वसुधा समिट 2027 (Hindi)](https://timeslanguages.in/nbtvasudha/hi/): the same page in Hindi
- [NBT Vasudha Sustainability Awards 2026 (English)](https://timeslanguages.in/nbtvasudha/awards.html): categories, judging pillars, nomination process, packages, FAQ
- [NBT वसुधा सस्टेनेबिलिटी अवॉर्ड्स 2026 (Hindi)](https://timeslanguages.in/nbtvasudha/hi/awards.html): the same page in Hindi

## Summit 2027: key facts

- Date and venue: 13 February 2027, Bharat Mandapam, Pragati Maidan, New Delhi
- Format: one day, five conversations: nation-building and net zero; natural capital and finance; village to global; policy and compliance, sized right; the language bridge. Every session has live Hindi–English interpretation.
- Schedule: 9:30 AM check-in and expo · 11:00 AM inaugural session · 11:45 AM track sessions 1 · 1:30 PM lunch and networking · 2:30 PM track sessions 2 · 6:30 PM awards gala
- Delegate passes: Bharat Pass ₹999 (all-inclusive; students, NGO staff, grassroots entrepreneurs) · Professional Pass ₹5,999 + GST · Vasudha Leadership Pass ₹19,999 + GST (includes awards gala) · Corporate Table, 10 seats, ₹1,75,000 + GST
- The summit is ticketed and open to the public; no invitation is needed.

## Sustainability Awards 2026: key facts

- Awards night: 13 February 2027 from 6:30 PM, Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi
- 34 categories in four tracks: Climate & Energy (8), Mobility & Circularity (8), Lifestyle & Nature (8), Finance, Health & Leaders (10)
- Judging: an independent jury scores every nomination on four pillars (innovation, impact, leadership, transformation) and on measurable results and scalability. Paying a fee does not guarantee an award.
- Nomination packages (all + GST): Individual Growth ₹8,999 (1 category) · Individual Acceleration ₹17,999 (2 categories) · Corporate Standard ₹25,999 (1 category) · Corporate Growth ₹34,999 (2 categories) · Corporate Acceleration ₹51,999 (3 categories)
- Process: choose a category → select a plan → submit story and proof → screening → independent jury → awards night

## Organisers

- Presented by Navbharat Times (The Times of India group) and Times Internet Languages Live (https://timeslanguages.in)
